items.description:
Welcome to the Euston Club Riverfront Resort

We have 2 x 22kW EV charging stations under the cover of our solar carport next to the Club. Charge cables (Type 1 & Type 2 compatible) are available from Reception. Download the Chargebay app to enable charging.

Euston is a historic and scenic town in south-western NSW, across the Murray River from Robinvale in Victoria. It is skirted by one of Australia's busiest highways, the Sturt Highway, an important road link between Sydney and Adelaide and the regions adjacent to the route. The club is nestled amongst the natural beauty of the red river gums on the picturesque banks of the mighty Murray. 

With more than 2 hectares of stunning grounds and modern facilities, Euston Club's members and visitors are spoiled for choice, with a variety of options for accommodation, dining, entertainment, business, relaxation and recreation.

Euston Club is open 7 days a week from 10.30am - 11.00pm. Drop in and let our friendly team look after you with some refreshments while your EV charges, or book in for few days to relax and enjoy the beautiful surrounds.

Ku-ring-gai Council owned and operated chargers. Two Exploren EV charge points with up to 60 kW* shared between the two charge points. Tethered.

Step 1: Tap the QR code symbol on the bottom right of the app
Step 2: Scan the QR code on the yellow Exploren sticker
Step 3: Read the charger description and press “Start Charging”
Step 4: Plug the cable to your vehicle
Step 5: Plug the cable to the charger
Step 6: If you want to stop the session during the charge, simply press “Stop Charging from the app"

Council contracted security closes the gate at approx. 10pm every night. They kindly inform you whenever they arrive that they are closing the gates soon.

For issues, contact Exploren 1300 755 087 or help@exploren.com.au.

*May be throttled down dependent on site demand.

The station includes 900kW of DC super-fast chargers consisting of two 360 kW chargers with dual CCS2 plugs and one 180kW charger with dual plugs (one CCS2 and one CHAdeMO), and two 20kW AC charger ports providing a total of 940kW charging capacity. Parking is free while charging and there are a couple of short term parking bays available while waiting for the chargers.

The EV charging bays are located directly adjacent to the community heart of UOW (directly West of the chargers) which offers a range of facilities including several food and café outlets, a grocery store, games arcade, post office, GP clinic and mental health practice, pharmacy, hairdresser, and library. Additionally, a complete gym, swimming pool and tennis courts are available as well as numerous locations for commuters to relax and recharge before continuing their journey. This includes numerous lawns and water features within UOW grounds or the Wollongong Botanical Gardens located directly south of the University. 

The charging bays are available 24/7 with campus security available onsite at any time (02 4221 4900) with the bays covered by public lighting and CCTV security cameras.
